test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Currently, Mittu and Bittu ________ hard to meet the project deadline.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. are working.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins with "**Currently**," indicating an action that is happening at the present moment.
 
• The present continuous tense "**are working**" correctly expresses ongoing action.
 
• The other options do not fit the context of an ongoing current action:
 
 
• "**Worked**" is past tense.
 
• **"Have worked**" is present perfect tense.
 
• **"Were working**" is past continuous tense.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
